moves.name:
Profusion of Flowers
Energy Ball
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is raised.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. If the remaining MP for the user’s [Name:MoveId Idx="18501" ] is [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] and grants the following three effects: This attack’s power increases.
(This attack powers up by 400%.) Lowers the target’s Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Restores the user’s HP by approximately [Digit:2digits Idx="2" ]% of its maximum HP. If the remaining MP for the user’s [Name:MoveId Idx="18501" ] is [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] and grants the following three effects: This attack’s power increases.
(This attack powers up by 200%.) Lowers the target’s Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Restores the user’s HP by approximately [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]% of its maximum HP. If the remaining MP for the user’s [Name:MoveId Idx="18501" ] is [Digit:1digit Idx="5" ] when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by [Digit:1digit Idx="5" ] and grants the following three effects: This attack’s power increases.
(This attack powers up by 50%.) Lowers the target’s Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by [Digit:1digit Idx="5" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="5" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Restores the user’s HP by approximately [Digit:2digits Idx="6" ]% of its maximum HP. If the remaining MP for the user’s [Name:MoveId Idx="18501" ] is zero when attacking with this move, has a chance ([Digit:2digits Idx="6" ]%) of lowering the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="7" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="5" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="5" S="rank" P="ranks" ].

Grants all of the following effects when the user is attacking:
Ignores the target’s passive skills that would reduce the damage of attacks.
Ignores the target’s passive skills that would protect the target against a critical hit.
Ignores the target’s Enduring effect.
